system.description:
Lutra Traits

Characters with the lutra heritage share a variety of traits with one another.

Age. Lutra age and mature at a similar rate to humans.

Size. Lutra are typically a similar size to humans, standing about 5–6 feet tall and weigh between 110–130 lbs. Seafaring lutrae are often broader and heavier in build to account for their thick fur and their ability to resist frigid water temperatures. Your size is Medium.

Speed. Your base Speed is 30 feet.

Playful Prankster. You gain proficiency in Sleight of Hand, or an expertise die if you were already proficient, and you may always choose to use Charisma when making your checks with this skill.

Rudder Tail. You gain a swim speed equal to your Speed, and you may swim without the use of your hands or feet.

Waterway Navigator. So long as you are on a boat or near a large body of flowing water (such as a river), you always know which direction is north.

Lutra Gifts

In addition to the traits found in your lutra heritage, select one of the following gifts.

Skipping Stones

You may use small stones that you find as improvised weapons. You are considered proficient with these stones and they deal 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier, whichever is highest. You may also use this ability to throw sling bullets without the use of a sling.

Slip and Slide

You gain an expertise die on checks made to resist being grappled and the grappled condition.

Additionally, so long as the surface that you are currently on is not considered difficult terrain, when you take the Dash action you may choose to slide an additional 10 feet in the direction in which you were traveling. This movement must be in a straight line and cannot be broken up in any way, and it does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Waverider

You have resistance to cold damage and the effects of freezing weather.

Your eyes are also specially adjusted to spotting threats in the murky depths. So long as you are submerged in water, you gain an expertise die to Perception checks that rely on sight.

Lutra Paragon

When you reach 10th level, you become a better lutra and gain one paragon gift from the following list.

Bubble Armor

When your fur is wet, your pelt traps bubbles within it, granting you a +1 bonus to your AC. If you are fully submerged in water, this bonus increases to +2. This bonus lasts until you exit the water or your fur becomes dry from a spell or environmental effect.

Show No Fear

You may choose to negate the frightened condition on yourself as a free action. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again until you complete a long rest.

Slippery Situation

Prerequisite: Slip and Slide heritage gift

You are immune to the grappled condition.

Additionally, when you use your Slip and Slide ability, you may now slide 20 feet.
